parsedVerdict.reasoning: Most of the module holds together: it is a set of use cases, one class per file, each with an execute method, plus a shared dtos.ts. One file breaks this. ListTasksUseCase in list-tasks-use-case.ts has a public method validateExecute(dto: CreateProjectDto). That method copies the project-name rule ("name is required") from CreateProjectUseCase.execute, so the same invariant now lives in two places. It also mixes project-creation validation into the task-listing use case, which is an unrelated concern. ListTasksUseCase.execute never calls it. The rest of the unit is consistent. A similar name check exists in CreateUserUseCase, but it applies to a different entity, so it is a minor overlap rather than the main problem.
